record_title: Unit orbits determine relative rank in finite transformation wreath products
provenance: An exact unit-orbit formula for relative rank in finite transformation wreath products, with a correction and extension of a recent transitivity-based argument.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Special full-transformation and symmetric-group wreath-product rank results are prior art. Lu's 2026 thesis and Meldrum's 1995 monograph are the main residual risks for an equivalent implicit statement and were not exhaustively checked for every formulation. The theorem is restricted to finite transformation monoids. No independent validation is asserted.
